business.snapshotBasis: Latest actual date present in supplied consumption_daily rows
business.activityRule: Opened on/before snapshot, no closure on/before snapshot, and a supplied usage row on snapshot date. Missing opening or snapshot evidence is unknown and excluded. Known later openings are counted separately. Disconnected supply does not imply account closure.

geographySource.name: GeoNames AU postal extract and 12 reviewed Q3 SILO reference points

business.geographyMeaning: Named approximate locality reference points, not postcode boundaries, customer coordinates or actual retailer coverage. GeoNames is community sourced; no ABS crosswalk is inferred.

coverage.completeness: Reviewed complete source tables for this exact retained cohort and recorded window; no claim of complete daily usage.

support.classification: Historical synthetic support context; no individual risk score

definitions.activeSupport: Distinct accounts active at the business snapshot with a recorded active support interval; start inclusive, end exclusive. Arrangement and hardship counts can overlap; union counts once.
definitions.grantHistory: Cleared, parent-joined grant ledger events for retained source accounts in the recorded month. Does not assert account activity at unobserved dates. Grant amounts are counted once, not added again from payments.
definitions.unavailable: Missing sidecars produce unavailable context, never zero support counts.
definitions.paymentDifficulty: Active arrangement participation is dated support context, not a general payment-difficulty or risk classification.
